description: This Java class defines the SubscriptionComplete event, which is emitted after all pages of a search subscription are sent. It includes methods for creating instances, deserializing from JSON, and managing event metadata.

classes.name: SubscriptionComplete
classes.description: Final class representing an event emitted after completing a search subscription, with methods for creation, JSON deserialization, and header management.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new SubscriptionComplete instance with specified subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionComplete instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path associated with this event, which is empty.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new SubscriptionComplete instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the JSON object builder; no payload for this event.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SubscriptionComplete object.
